leadText:
Rhoda (Japanese: レース Res) is a character of the day who appeared in Hail to the Chef!. 

She is a restaurant manager who lives near Saffron City. After competing with her younger twin sister, , for the inheritance of her father's restaurant, she decided to give it to her sister after seeing how she handled the situation when their Pokémon were taken by . As she was leaving, her sister hired her as the restaurant's co-manager and her Sneasel as its head chef. After that, their Pokémon cooked delicious food together for and .

==Trivia==
In both Japanese and English, Rhoda's name is a match to her sister's. In the English, there is only a one-letter difference in their names, while in Japanese, both Res and Toran are derived from restaurant.
